description: Margin discriminator (kill-check MAJOR-2, dyadic fix): all times k/2^n so the float margin is BIT-EXACT. 'bb' [0.875,1.375] over the 1.0 s boundary: cluster0 overlap 1-0.875 = 0.125, cluster1 overlap 1.375-1 = 0.375 (both exact dyadic) -> plain winner SPK_2 with margin 0.375-0.125 === 0.25 EXACTLY: '< DIAR_HYSTERESIS_SEC' is false -> the switch happens (widening the rule to '<=' would carry SPK_1 and go red). 'cc' [1.45,1.85] over the 1.6 s boundary: winner SPK_1 margin ~0.10 (< 0.25 with ulp noise BELOW the threshold, so both '<' and '<=' carry) -> CARRIES previous speaker SPK_2 although the duration-weighted winner is SPK_1. 'dd' switches cleanly (margin ~0.4).
